newsitem.title: UK: J Walter Thompson Finland merges with Interplan.
newsitem.headline: J Walter Thompson Finland merges with Interplan.

text.p: J. Walter Thompson Finland Oy, the Finnish unit of the global advertising agency owned by WPP Group Plc, said on Tuesday it has merged with Interplan AB in Helsinki to form a new agency, Thompson-Interplan Oy.
The new agency, expected to be one of the bigger Finnish agencies, will employ about 26 people and achieve a gross margin of 12 million markka in 1996.
Interplan, a former Saatchi & Saatchi unit, has been looking for an international partner for the past two years after its agreement with Saatchi's came to an end.
JWT said its Finnish unit had been looking for a partner in order to expand its business and capitalise on the worldwide JWT network.
